_comment: Operator-curated layer->operator and borough-president jurisdiction assertions for the areas[] axis (issue #1 phase 4, 2026-07-15). Hand-authored (parallel to data/curation.json), applied at build time by build_registry.apply_boundaries_mapping. `operates_layer` attaches areas[]{scheme:'nyc-boundaries', layer, id:null, role:'operates_layer'} to the entity that administers a whole district system; `jurisdictions` attaches areas[]{scheme:'us_census_geoid', layer:'county', id:<FIPS>, role:'jurisdiction'} to the 5 borough-president offices (nyc-boundaries has NO borough layer, so the national scheme carries the footprint). Every attach adds the 'manual' provenance source. `defines_not_operates`, `no_registry_entity`, and `deferred` are NON-attaching records that make coverage of all 22 nyc-boundaries layers EXPLICIT and auditable — they document WHY a layer was not linked. Layer ids are validated against data/nyc_boundaries_layers.json (the committed vocabulary extracted by sync_boundaries.py); an unknown layer id is a build error. Justifications quote the staged layer description (data/cache/nyc-boundaries_layers_index.ts, fetched 2026-07-15) — the authoritative layer vocabulary. County FIPS are the US Census Bureau's stable county GEOIDs (state 36 = NY + 3-digit county). Entity ids verified present in data/registry.json (317 entities). No entities are minted here (t3jq carries one generic 'Community Boards' entity, not 59 boards — per-board linkage is DEFERRED until a source asserts individual boards; see deferred_per_board below).

source.county_fips_authority: US Census Bureau — county GEOID (state FIPS 36 = New York + 3-digit county code); TIGER/Gazetteer stable public identifiers

operates_layer.justification: NYPD administers the police-precinct district system. Staged description (pp): 'A police precinct is a geographical area patrolled by the NYPD.'

Police sectors are NYPD operational units. Staged description (ps): 'A police sector is a subdivision of a police precinct.' Same administering agency as pp; attached beyond the phase-4 confirmed set because it is unambiguously NYPD-operated and directly sourced.
DSNY administers the sanitation-district system. Staged description (dsny): 'For operations management, the Department of Sanitation (DSNY) divides the city into 59 Sanitation Districts.'

FDNY administers fire battalions. Staged description (fb): 'A Fire Battalion consists of several fire stations and multiple fire companies, and is led by a Battalion Chief' — an FDNY command structure.
The NYC Department of Education administers community school districts. Staged description (sd): 'A School District is a geographical area with multiple schools' (description_url schools.nyc.gov).

The City Council's 51 members are elected from the 51 council districts. Staged description (cc): 'The New York City Council is the lawmaking body of New York City. It has 51 members from 51 council districts.'

Community Boards are the governance body of community districts. Staged description (cd): 'Community Boards advise on land use and zoning ... and address service delivery in their district.' Whole-layer reference on the single generic 'Community Boards' registry entity (t3jq carries one entity, not 59 boards).

The NYC Board of Elections administers election districts. Staged description (ed): 'Election Districts are the smallest electoral units in New York City, used for the purpose of conducting elections' (description_url vote.nyc).

jurisdictions.justification: The Manhattan Borough President's footprint is New York County. nyc-boundaries has no borough layer, so the national us_census_geoid scheme carries it. FIPS 36061 (state 36 + county 061).
The Bronx Borough President's footprint is Bronx County. FIPS 36005 (state 36 + county 005).
The Brooklyn Borough President's footprint is Kings County. FIPS 36047 (state 36 + county 047).
The Queens Borough President's footprint is Queens County. FIPS 36081 (state 36 + county 081).
The Staten Island Borough President's footprint is Richmond County. FIPS 36085 (state 36 + county 085).

defines_not_operates.note: Statistical geography, NOT an administered district system. Staged description (nta): 'Neighborhood Tabulation Areas are aggregations of census tracts, adapted as a method of presenting the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS).' DCP builds NTAs but they are a tabulation/reporting geography — the role vocabulary offers only operates_layer/jurisdiction, and 'defines a statistical geography' is neither. Not attached rather than stretch operates_layer semantics.

Statistical geography defined BY DCP but not operated as a district system. Staged description (cdta): 'They are defined by the NYC Department of City Planning in order to report American Community Survey (ACS) data.' 'Defined ... in order to report' is a tabulation geography, not governance. Not attached (see nta).

Health reporting geography, not an administered district system. Staged description (hc): 'Health Center Districts are aggregates of health areas and are used for reporting health statistics. They were created by the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).' Created for reporting; not attached.

Health-research geography co-defined by NYC agencies and the (non-registry) United Hospital Fund. Staged description (uhf): 'In the 1980s, NYC city agencies and the United Hospital Fund (UHF) defined neighborhood schemes for health research.' A research/reporting scheme, not a governed district system; not attached.

no_registry_entity.note: State legislative districting. Staged description (sa): 'The New York State Assembly is the lower house of the New York State Legislature ... There are 150 seats in the Assembly.' The Assembly is a NYS body; this registry currently holds only NYC-level entities (303 nyc + 12 authority + 1 bi-state + 1 pbc; no NYS executive/legislative seeds). No registry entity to link; recorded for coverage.

State legislative districting. Staged description (ss): 'The New York State Senate is the upper house of the New York State Legislature ... There are 63 seats in the Senate.' NYS body, not in this registry. No registry entity to link.

Federal congressional districting. Staged description (nycongress): 'Congressional Districts are the 435 regions from which voting representatives are elected to the U.S. House of Representatives.' Federal body, not in this registry. No registry entity to link.

Federal statistical geography. Staged description (puma): 'The Census Bureau defines Public Use Microdata Areas (PUMAs) ...' Defined by the federal Census Bureau (not in this registry) and statistical, not governed. No registry entity to link.
Postal geography. Staged description (zipcode): 'A ZIP Code is a postal code used by the United States Postal Service (USPS).' Federal USPS, not in this registry. No registry entity to link.

no_registry_entity.would_be_operator: New York State Unified Court System
no_registry_entity.note: Court jurisdiction geography. Staged description (mc): 'Municipal Court Districts are the geographic areas in which municipal courts have jurisdiction.' NYC's civil/criminal courts are part of the NYS Unified Court System (state judiciary), not in this registry. No registry entity to link.

deferred.note: Business Improvement Districts are individually operated by local BID management associations (nonprofits) under NYC Small Business Services (SBS) program oversight — not a single-agency district system. Staged description (bid): 'local stakeholders oversee and fund the maintenance, improvement, and promotion of their commercial district' (description_url sbs .../bids.page). Deferred: program-oversight is neither operates_layer (SBS does not administer the districts) nor jurisdiction; revisit if a per-BID or SBS-administers source is asserted.

Historic Districts are designated by the NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC). Deferred: the staged file carries NO description for hd (name only), so 'operates' cannot be sourced from the layer vocabulary; designation is arguably not operation of a district system. Revisit with an LPC-administers source.

Industrial Business Zones are an industrial-policy designation. Staged description (ibz): 'a geographic area that serve as safe havens for manufacturing and industrial firms' (description_url edc.nyc). Administered jointly across SBS/NYCEDC industrial programs; operator is ambiguous and it is a policy designation, not a governed district system. Deferred.

Neighborhood Development Areas are a designation for tax-incentive eligibility. Staged description (nda): 'a designated area where developers can receive tax incentives for building affordable housing and community facilities' (description_url dycd .../nab-nda-maps.page). A designation tied to DYCD programs, not a governed district system DYCD administers. Deferred.

deferred_per_board.note: The registry carries ONE generic 'Community Boards' entity (id: community-boards), not 59 individual community boards. The phase-4 spec's per-board linkage (each of the 59 boards -> its one cd district as a jurisdiction) is DEFERRED until a source asserts individual boards as entities. No entities are minted here. When such a source lands, mint 59 board entities and attach jurisdiction areas[]{scheme:'nyc-boundaries', layer:'cd', id:<district>}.
